novelty.justification: The novelty route is a mechanism/measurement hypothesis: the claim proposes that reaction transformers "internally represent the mechanistic electron flow" and that this representation is "causally linked to correct product prediction," extending beyond atom correspondence to nucleophile/electrophile roles and bond changes. Searches using "reaction transformer electron flow hidden states," "attention reaction center bond changes," and "curved-arrow mechanism probing transformer" identified Schwaller et al.'s Unsupervised Attention-Guided Atom-Mapping (2020), which showed that transformer attention encodes atom rearrangements, and FlowER, Electron flow matching for generative reaction mechanism prediction (2025), which explicitly models electron redistribution rather than discovering it inside a conventional predictor. Moving from attention-based atom mapping and reaction-center information to probing and intervening on a unified internal electron-flow variable is a non-trivial but natural extension using standard mechanistic-interpretability tools, so the contribution is best characterized as a substantive new operationalization rather than a new core paradigm.
